critical_code_review_comments: /api/canon/static does NOT expose the canon VERSION — the request literally says 'GET /api/canon/static → VERSION "1.3"'. VERSION is instead served by /api/canon/validation. Consider adding {'version': canon()['document']['version']} to /api/canon/static so clients don't need a second call. Non-blocking (validation endpoint covers the requirement).
